key_idea: The central idea is to construct a relaxed polynomial using quadratic chirps to spread out frequencies uniformly, pack these frequency bands combinatorially without overlap, and use discrepancy theory to round the continuous coefficients into discrete signs.
reason: This proof elegantly resolves a notoriously difficult problem by synthesizing methods from harmonic analysis and combinatorics, most notably discrepancy theory. Although integrating these heavy tools requires a chain of technical lemmas and careful bookkeeping, the overarching conceptual pipeline is remarkably surprising and cohesive.
recognized: Balister, Bollobás, Morris, Sahasrabudhe, and Tointon: Flat Littlewood Polynomials Exist
